reviews.title: Price Increase?
reviews.text: From $2.99 to $6.99 is ridiculous. Loved the app but that’s too much of a price increase for how much I use it. Cancelling.

reviews.title: Cancellation Complexity
reviews.text: Please make cancelation easier, it’s unfair. that you set this up for auto renewal. I never selected that. I used this once or twice, several years ago.

reviews.title: Can’t log in now
reviews.text: Since latest update I can not log in says incorrect credentials. They are correct. As a last resort I requested a password reset, but not received the email and not in the junk folder either. My subscription is still valid so what have you done?

reviews.title: Terrible filtering, boring rehashed content, impossible to cancel
reviews.text: Been a member for 6 years, same repetitive content. Mostly caters to men, little for women or mixed groups. Biggest complaint is the ability to filter. No filters for group size, tone, or family-friendly options, so you have to click into every clip just to check if it fits. Try finding content that fits your 4 bffs. Also very little diversity. Canceling through the app is nearly impossible. Expected more after years of paying for this. So many more options out there. Finally cancelled my subscription that I would’ve used a lot more had it been easier to use.

reviews.title: Scam!
reviews.text: This app is a complete scam that annually steals $24.00 from your credit card. I attempted to cancel this for moths and was unable to. I knew the last date my subscription ran out and still couldn’t cancel. I deleted the app and “all the data” got hit for a $24.00 charge the next day. Save yourself the aggravation of dealing with a disputed charge. DO NOT DOWLOAD the app. These people should be in jail for outright deception, bank fraud  and theft.

reviews.title: Cute but Annoying
reviews.text: I used it for birthday ecard. It said free 30 days but after I signed up and payed it said non-refundable. Had to jump through hoops to cancel my membership and then it said it can’t be cancelled until the payed subscription year is up and they keep your data. Don’t get this, it’s too much of a hassle.

reviews.title: Wayyy too commercialized.
reviews.text: I want the old gif gab back, where I could just create stuff and send it in a text. Now they have to click on a link and there’s all the other buttons for them to sign up or create their own- it totally detracts from the fun text. I thought the paid version would be different, so I paid, but it’s not. I really just want the old GifGab back, it worked perfectly.
